investment_strategy: Construct a quality-biased, AI-focused core-and-satellite portfolio aligned with a constructive-but-selective market. With VIX ~16 (benign but not complacent) and the 10Y at 4.57% (higher discount rate), overweight cash-generative, wide-moat platforms and moderate-volatility infrastructure beneficiaries, while capping high-beta chip exposure. Emphasize companies with strong analyst consensus, robust earnings/revenue growth, and demonstrated execution in AI platforms or data center build-outs. Balance ‘platform’ (software/cloud/search) and ‘picks-and-shovels’ (networking, memory, compute) to capture secular AI demand while diversifying supply-chain/regulatory risks. Deploy full capital now, monitor earnings/revisions, export-control headlines, and data center energy constraints; rebalance quarterly or on 15–20% position moves.

portfolio_summary.strategy_focus: Quality AI platforms plus diversified infrastructure (networking, compute, memory) with capped high-beta exposure under a higher-rate, selectively constructive market.

analysis_summary.selection_criteria: Prioritized low-to-moderate volatility, strong earnings/revenue growth, positive momentum, and positive analyst consensus; balanced platform and infrastructure exposure; sized positions by beta/volatility and policy/energy risks.
analysis_summary.market_outlook: AI demand remains robust across software and hardware; hyperscaler capex and HBM/networking drive infrastructure cycles. Elevated valuations and regulatory/export-control/energy constraints introduce volatility, favoring diversified, quality-centric exposure with disciplined sizing.
